messages:
liam (Partnerships): Vendor reported intermittent reboots on H200 blades in eu-west during high-concurrency multi-tenant runs. They suspect power-sequencing + firmware interaction. Want guidance: quiet swap vs joint advisory?

nina (Sales Ops): We have 4 enterprise customers with reserved H200 for next week. Quiet swap preferred but need a commercial fallback (credit or same-price on alternate HW).

rohan (Eng-ML): From our traces: kernel OOMs correlate with concurrency >120 and long-context batches. Logs: [WARN nvlink reset] [ERROR firmware power_seq_timeout] [INFO watchdog kill].

tara (Infrastructure): Ops options: 1) enforce per-tenant concurrency caps; 2) fallback to MI300 in-region; 3) schedule vendor firmware patch (requires cold reboot). I recommend 1+2 immediately.

kevin (Partner Eng): Vendor canary: BMC firmware v1.2.4 available, needs maintenance window and cold reboot. They offered canary on 2 racks tomorrow 02:00 UTC; GA in ~36h after validation.

liam (Partnerships): Plan: flip runtime caps now, coordinate canary with vendor, hold press unless vendor requests embargo.

nina (Sales Ops): I'll draft customer communications offering opt-in to MI300 move or temporary credit. ETA 30m.

rohan (Eng-ML): Router snippet to enable now: 
```n/routing:
- match: "/models/redwood/h200"
  concurrency_cap: 80
  max_batch: 6
  fallbacks: ["/models/redwood/mi300-eu","/models/redwood/h100-eu"]
  billing_notice: "fallback_cost_delta"
```
PR incoming.

tara (Infrastructure): Adding alerts: node_reboot_count >3 per rack in 30m; firmware_errors >0. Quarantine rule if reboot_count>=5. Adding SSH checklist for oncall to capture dmesg and BMC logs.

kevin (Partner Eng): Vendor prefers quiet patching unless we publish joint advisory. I'll keep them in the loop for canary results.

comms-bot: scheduled-message: Post updates to #support and #eng-oncall after changes.

liam (Partnerships): Owners: Rohan PR (10m), Tara alerts/runbook (20m), Nina customer comms (30m), Kevin vendor canary coord. Reconvene after PR + comms review.
